title: A Large-scale Study of Spatiotemporal Representation Learning with a New Benchmark on Action Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating spatiotemporal models across a diverse benchmark (BEAR) of 18 video datasets spanning 5 distinct domains and varying viewpoints to measure cross-domain generalization and prevent biased evaluations resulting from overfitting to homogeneous, widely-used datasets like Kinetics-400.

Standardizing fair comparisons by strictly withholding test sets during hyperparameter tuning and analyzing both CNN and Transformer models equipped with comparable backbones to prevent unfair architectural advantages.
